name: twg
description:
Your code lives in your repo. The reasons behind it are spread across Jira work items, Confluence specs, pull requests, incidents, Loom videos, and Slack threads.

Teamwork Graph CLI (twg) gives Codex one command-line interface to that context.

- One graph across your tools: Teamwork Graph maps the work items, docs, PRs, people and decisions across Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket, Jira Service Management, Loom, GitHub, Slack, Google Drive and Salesforce.
- Built for agents: Codex runs twg commands to retrieve structured JSON, pulling in only the context needed for the task. Start with a work item, follow it to the linked spec, then the related PR.
- Easy to script: Output is structured JSON, so you can script it, pipe it, or use it in CI.
- Runs as you: Commands use your Atlassian sign-in, so Codex can only access what you have permission to see.

How it works:
1. Install the plugin.
2. Run /twg-setup to install twg and sign in with your Atlassian account.
3. Ask in plain English. Codex picks the right twg command and runs it.

Using ChatGPT in the browser? Install the Atlassian Rovo MCP plugin instead.

Try it:
- "Draft a Jira work item from this PR and link it to the epic"
- "Find the Confluence spec for this service and check my branch against it"
- "What changed on <insert name> project since I last touched it? Include linked PRs"
